name: Embeddings Databricks
category_description: AI cluster sub-node (model, memory, tool, parser)
description: Use the Embeddings Databricks node to generate embeddings[^1] for text with an embeddings model served by your Databricks workspace. The node queries Unity AI Gateway model services, the same gateway the Databricks Chat Model node uses. Its main job is to pair with the Databricks Vector Store node, which needs an embeddings connection in every operation mode

parameters.name: Model
parameters.description: The Unity AI Gateway model service that generates the embeddings, named catalog.schema.service

parameters.name: Batch Size
parameters.description: The maximum number of documents to send in one request. Default 512, maximum 2048. Refer to Rate limits before lowering it

parameters.name: Strip New Lines
parameters.description: Whether to remove new line characters from the input text before embedding it. Turned on by default

parameters.name: Timeout
parameters.description: The maximum time a request may take, in milliseconds. Default 360000 (six minutes). A request that runs out of time fails with Request timed out

parameters.name: Max Retries
parameters.description: How many times to retry a failed request. Default 2

parameters.name: notice
parameters.displayName: This node must be connected to a vector store. Insert one

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: The Unity AI Gateway model service. Choose from the list, or enter its full name (catalog.schema.service).

options.name: batchSize
options.description: Maximum number of documents to send in each request

options.name: stripNewLines
options.description: Whether to strip new lines from the input text

options.name: timeout
options.description: Maximum amount of time a request is allowed to take in milliseconds

options.name: maxRetries
options.description: Maximum number of retries to attempt
